subject: PeakBank: staged rollback verification and VM evidence
body:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@peakbank.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: security@peakbank.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Proof of remediations + rollback test for CVE-2026-1173

Hi Laura,

Per PeakBank's audit, we need an evidence packet for the recent CVE-2026-1173 remediation that affected the Private deployment we run in our VPC. Specifically we need:

- Patch manifest showing which instances were patched and when.
- Scan snapshot pre- and post-patch.
- A short statement on rollback behavior: how a staged rollback would look and whether rollbacks reintroduce the vulnerability.

We have an internal deadline for the audit on Oct 5; can you confirm we’ll have artifacts no later than Sep 30?

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Lead, Information Security
PeakBank

-----Original Message (quoted for context removed)-----

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Alex Rivera


From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: alex.rivera@peakbank.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:02:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Proof of remediations + rollback test for CVE-2026-1173

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. I’ll coordinate across Security and CS.

Cc'ing Kimberly (security ops) and Monica (CS lead for PeakBank) to own the artifacts and timeline.

Action plan (high level):
1) Kimberly will pull the pre/post scan snapshots and generate a patch_manifest.csv with instance IDs + timestamps.
2) We will run a staged rollback test in our dev replica cluster to confirm rollback behavior and produce a one-page summary.
3) Deliverables pushed to a shared Drive folder and link provided here.

Kimberly/Monica — can you confirm by EOD that you can deliver by Sep 30 and flag any blockers?

— Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com; monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com; grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PeakBank: staged rollback verification and VM evidence

Laura / Monica — confirmed. We already have scan snapshots taken on 2026-09-27 (pre-patch) and 2026-09-29 (post-patch). I will: 

- Export the Nessus/Trivy scan JSONs and include them as peakbank_scan_snapshot_20260927.json and peakbank_scan_snapshot_20260929.json.
- Produce a patch_manifest_20260929.csv listing hostnames/instance IDs, agent versions, CVE remediation commits, and exact timestamps.
- Execute a staged rollback on the dev replica on Sep 30 (09:00–11:00 PT) and capture the rollback_test_report_20260930.pdf with steps, outcome, and verification scripts.

One note on rollback behavior: the patch for CVE-2026-1173 is a library-level upgrade (libnet v4.2.1 -> 4.3.0) plus a config flag; a rollback that reverts the library without reverting the config will leave the service vulnerable. Our staged rollback test will therefore include both library and config reversion to validate the full rollback path. We’ll document required steps to avoid partial rollback risk.

Deliverables will be uploaded to the shared Drive folder and I’ll paste the link here by EOD Sep 29. If PeakBank needs signed attestations, flag that and we’ll have Legal prepare a short attestation.

Attachments (referenced): [attachment: peakbank_scan_snapshot_20260927.json (JSON scan export)], [attachment: patch_manifest_20260929.csv (CSV)]

— Kimberly Park
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com; laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PeakBank: staged rollback verification and VM evidence

Thanks Kimberly — appreciate the clarity. Monica here to confirm CS will coordinate access for PeakBank's InfoSec to the Drive folder and can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough (Sep 30, 11:30 PT) of the artifacts and the rollback test steps. Ben — can you confirm if legal/signature is needed for the attestation?

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@peakbank.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com; laura.bennett@redwood.com; monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 07:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PeakBank: staged rollback verification and VM evidence

Thanks Kimberly/Monica — that timeline works. A couple quick asks: 

1) Can the patch_manifest include the commit SHA or package checksum for each patched artifact? We need cryptographic proof the patched binary is the one you claim.
2) Please indicate whether any instances were given temporary exceptions (IIS/legacy nodes) and the mitigation for them.

I’ll plan to join the walkthrough at 11:30 PT.

— Alex

-----Original Message-----
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@peakbank.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com; monica.patel@redwood.com; ben.carter@redwood.com; grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PeakBank: staged rollback verification and VM evidence

Alex — quick update post-walkthrough:

- Patch manifest now includes package checksums and the commit SHAs for our compiled artifacts (see patch_manifest_20260929.csv).
- Two legacy IIS nodes were put into an exception window; both were isolated behind a firewall rule and monitored with increased EDR sampling — documented in the manifest.
- Rollback test was executed against the dev replica; the rollback_report demonstrates that a library-only rollback reintroduces the vulnerability, but the full rollback (library + config) restores the pre-patch state without reintroducing other regressions. Steps and scripts attached.

We uploaded the artifacts to the Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example

If PeakBank requires a signed attestation letter for SOC 2 evidence, we can route that to Legal — let me know and I’ll get Ben and Legal looped.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

— Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

[attachments: peakbank_scan_snapshot_20260927.json, peakbank_scan_snapshot_20260929.json, patch_manifest_20260929.csv, rollback_test_report_20260930.pdf]
